setup: primary="$(dirname "$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir)")" && mkdir -p .chainlink .deciduous && ln -sfn "$primary/.chainlink/issues.db" .chainlink/issues.db && ln -sfn "$primary/.deciduous/deciduous.db" .deciduous/deciduous.db && ln -sfn "$primary/.deciduous/config.toml" .deciduous/config.toml && ln -sfn "$primary/models" models && cargo fetch -q && npm --prefix web ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix web run build
sessionSetup: umask 077 && touch .env && rm -f .env.sesh && grep -v '^PORT=' .env > .env.sesh; echo "PORT=$SESH_SESSION_PORT" >> .env.sesh && mv .env.sesh .env
